# Show Definition

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets the definition of a word.

## Syntax

~~~~text
showDefinition(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
showDefinition(text: "Cat")
~~~~
